title: eforecast trial
description: One trial in depth: its error after each epoch, the loop it is in and how fast, its pace, and what it uses. With All above it follows the training: the figures are those of the trial that started last, the curves those of every trial of the time range. Choose a cluster, a method and a trial to keep one of them; the newest is first in each list, and a trial that has ended can be chosen as long as the time range still covers it. The first line says what is training now, whatever is chosen.

links.title: Follow the training
links.tooltip: back to All: the trial that is training now, and each one after it

links.title: Optuna dashboard
links.tooltip: every study and trial, with its curves and parameters

panels.title: Training now
panels.description: One line per trial that is training at this moment, whatever is chosen above. If the rest of the page is empty, what is chosen is not one of these: it has ended and the time range has moved past it. Click a trial to choose it, or Follow the training (top right) to go back to All.

panels.title: Hyper-parameters (from the Optuna dashboard's database)
panels.description: What each trial chosen was trained with, as its study drew it, the trial its study asked for last first. Empty while the service optuna-mirror is not running, and for a trial no study drew (a transfer trial).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.value_json::json->>'cluster' AS cluster, m.value_json::json#>>'{}' AS method,
       f.value_json::json#>>'{}' AS trial, substr(p.param_name, length(m.value_json::json#>>'{}') + 2) AS parameter,
       CASE WHEN p.distribution_json::json->>'name' = 'CategoricalDistribution'
            THEN p.distribution_json::json->'attributes'->'choices'->>(p.param_value::int)
            WHEN p.param_value = round(p.param_value) THEN round(p.param_value)::bigint::text
            ELSE to_char(p.param_value, 'FM999999990.99999999') END AS value
  FROM trials t
  JOIN study_user_attributes a ON a.study_id = t.study_id AND a.key = 'eforecast_mirror'
  JOIN trial_user_attributes m ON m.trial_id = t.trial_id AND m.key = 'method'
  JOIN trial_user_attributes f ON f.trial_id = t.trial_id AND f.key = 'folder'
  JOIN trial_params p ON p.trial_id = t.trial_id AND p.param_name <> '(method)'
 WHERE a.value_json::json->>'case' ~ '^(${case:regex})$' AND a.value_json::json->>'cluster' ~ '^(${cluster:regex})$'
   AND m.value_json::json#>>'{}' ~ '^(${method:regex})$' AND f.value_json::json#>>'{}' ~ '^(${trial:regex})$'
 ORDER BY t.datetime_start DESC NULLS LAST, 1, 2, t.number DESC, p.param_name
 LIMIT 400
